definitions.gloss: construction; execution of building or civil engineering work
definitions.explanation: The process of carrying out construction or civil engineering projects according to design plans.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{施工|せこう}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Construction of this building is scheduled to begin next month.

examples.japanese: {施工|せこう}⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll have a meeting with the construction contractor.

examples.japanese: {施工|せこう}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
PRONUNCIATION NOTE:
・{施工|せこう} (せこう) - standard pronunciation
・{施工|しこう} - also acceptable, but less common in construction industry

DO NOT CONFUSE WITH:
・⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧ (implementation/enforcement of law) - same kanji reading pattern but different meaning

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{施工|せこう}⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (construction contractor)
・{施工|せこう}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (construction management)
・{施工|せこう}⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (construction drawing)
・{施工|せこう}{会社|がいしゃ} (construction company)
・{施工|せこう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (construction period)

CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY TERMS:
・⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧ (design)
・{施工|せこう} (construction)
・⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (inspection)
・⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧ (handover)
